name: Manganese
description: Trace element important for enzyme function and antioxidant defense.

name: Iron
description: Vital for oxygen transport; iron oxide nanoparticles are studied for imaging and therapy.

name: Cobalt
description: Component of vitamin B12; essential but toxic in high amounts.

name: Nickel
description: Essential trace element but some compounds are carcinogenic.

name: Copper
description: Copper imbalance is linked to cancer progression; targeted chelation is studied.

name: Zinc
description: Important for immune function, DNA repair, and enzyme activity.

name: Gallium
description: Used experimentally in cancer treatment for its ability to disrupt iron metabolism.

name: Germanium
description: Limited biological role; sometimes used in alternative medicine without proven benefits.

name: Arsenic
description: Used in arsenic trioxide chemotherapy for leukemia.

name: Selenium
description: Trace element with antioxidant properties; studied for cancer prevention.

name: Bromine
description: Limited biological role; compounds can be toxic.
